design_concept: Kinetic Restraint - A fusion of brutalist elite athletic performance and high-end editorial Swiss typography. Mobile-first layout emphasizing bold asymmetrical layouts, kinetic scroll-linked SVG motion, and stark monochromatic photography with sharp blue accents.

forbidden_colors: heavy black backgrounds except in block 4

rules.headers: Space Grotesk 700, ALL LOWERCASE. Use tracking-tighter for massive impact.
rules.accent_closings: Playfair Display italic in Brand Blue #1B33DC. Used for the blue closing of headers, numbers, and prices.
rules.overlines: Uppercase, tracking-[0.3em], preceded by a solid blue line. Example: `border-l-2 border-[#1B33DC] pl-3`.
rules.hierarchy: H1: text-[12vw] md:text-7xl leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter. Body: text-base md:text-lg text-[#616161] leading-relaxed.

visual_enhancers.arc_motif: A blue parabola SVG (representing a shooting trajectory) that travels across the page, ending in a solid blue dot. Must be animated using Framer Motion.
visual_enhancers.photography: Strictly Black & White. Use CSS `grayscale` if needed. Add decorative square brackets `[ ]` to the corners of image containers.
visual_enhancers.cards: Bone grey #F4F4F1, rounded-[18px], shadow-sm, with sharp inner paddings.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp, but for WhatsApp use floating Action Button with blue/brand colors as requested (or native green if conversion dictates, but prompt says 'CTAs de WhatsApp azuis'). Use Brand Blue for CTA.

layouts_and_grids.general: Mobile-first. Do NOT default to center alignment. Rely on the Swiss Grid and Asymmetry. Break elements out of standard containers by overlapping images and text.
layouts_and_grids.hero: Asymmetrical. Massive lowercase text overlapping a B&W kinetic athlete image. The blue arc starts here.
layouts_and_grids.problema: Bento-style or zig-zag overlap. 3 lines of text with the italic closing, juxtaposed heavily against a fatigued athlete image.
layouts_and_grids.enfoque: 3 step cards (01/02/03). Stacked vertically on mobile, side-by-side or masonry on desktop.
layouts_and_grids.el_club_y_tu: The ONLY dark block. bg-[#151515] with white text and blue accents. Embed the gym image with a subtle blend mode or sharp bracket frame.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth scrolling to give momentum.
motion_and_interaction.animations: Use `framer-motion` for scroll-triggered entrances. Cards should slide up and fade in with a slight delay stagger. The blue arc path should use `strokeDasharray` and `strokeDashoffset` to draw itself on scroll.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Slow, continuous editorial ribbon between Hero and Problema. Text: Ink #151515 on Bone #F4F4F1 background, interspersed with a solid blue dot.

hero_kinetic.description: B&W Action shot of a basketball player jumping. Use in the Hero section.
hero_kinetic.placement_instructions: Place on the right/background, overlapping with the giant hero text. Apply corner brackets `[ ]` via CSS.

problema_fatigue.description: B&W Close up of a tired, intensely breathing athlete.
problema_fatigue.placement_instructions: Use in the 'Problema' section. Clip or mask it into a striking vertical rectangle alongside the 3 pain points.

el_club_dark.description: B&W Dark gym pullup back shot.
el_club_dark.placement_instructions: Use in 'El Club y Tú'. Needs to sit on the #151515 background, perhaps with a linear gradient fading into the black.

component_structure.header: Sticky nav. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E5E0]. Logo left, anchor links center, ES/PT toggle right. z-50.
component_structure.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right z-50. bg-[#1B33DC] text-white rounded-full p-4 shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Google Fonts: Space Grotesk, Playfair Display, Inter, Caveat, Permanent Marker, Anton.
Build strictly as a single-page landing layout in React.
DO NOT modify the Plans, FAQ, Contact, or Footer sections. Build placeholders for them if needed, or assume they are appended below.
Ensure all text remains in Spanish as requested, with structural support for a PT toggle.

Enforce the 'Kinetic Restraint' brand tightly: no orange, no default blue backgrounds, stick to the Bone, Ink, and White palette with Brand Blue (#1B33DC) ONLY for accents, trajectories, and specific emphasis text.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered layouts, simplistic gradients).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Use targeted transitions.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect human natural reading flow.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use Tailwind spacing scale generously.
Ensure high contrast and accessibility on all text over images or dark backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images meets WCAG AA standards. Use text shadows or gradients where necessary.
accessibility.focus_states: All focusable elements must have an offset outline using Brand Blue (#1B33DC).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for Framer Motion animations.
